summary.text: Yavimaya is a heavily forested island of Dominaria, in the Terisian Isles, that grew into a single sapient mind.

bio.text: The Heart of Yavimaya grew near the river after the Sylex Blast, slowly forming the forest around it, and Fyndhorn refugees led by Kaysa and Jaeuhl Carthalion later fled there and made peace with Multani.
Multani, remembering Argoth's destruction, imprisoned Urza in a tree before the two became allies and Yavimaya strengthened against Phyrexia.
Rofellos took Multani's place as the voice of the forest for a time, and in the Phyrexian Invasion Multani transplanted part of Yavimaya to Urborg, spending nearly all his power.
During the temporal crisis a rift in Yavimaya suspended Multani, and Jeska sealed it through Radha.
Sixty years after the Mending Multani awakened in rage, Muldrotha was born on Urborg, and the Yavimayan elves lived as exiles until he calmed and they returned.
In Dominaria United, Rona attacked Yavimaya in a dragon engine, and Meria then pledged her people to the Coalition.

status.text: As of Dominaria United, Yavimaya had survived the dragon engine attack and its elves under Meria had joined the Coalition.
